Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an incorrect “baseline” by stating that Plunkett & Macleane was directed by Michael Caton-Jones. The film was actually directed by Jake Scott. This misrecall, likely due to confusing directors/films, could have led to identifying the wrong father had it not been corrected by subsequent verification.
